title_en: Gao Yulin et al. — Embezzlement and Bribery
keywords_en: criminal; embezzlement; bribery; first instance; intermediate people's court; Tianjin; state organ; Supplementary Provisions concerning the Punishment of Crimes of Embezzlement and Bribery; whether constitutes embezzlement; determination of principal and accessory offenders; determination of crime of bribery; partial support; embezzlement of education support funds; acceptance of kickbacks; illegal distribution of public funds
full_text_en:
Gao Yulin et al. (five persons): Embezzlement and Bribery Case

Defendant: Gao Yulin, male, 62 years old, from Tianjin, former Deputy Director of the Tianjin Education and Health Committee and concurrently Director of the Tianjin Education Enrollment Examination Center, arrested on July 2, 1996.

Defense counsel at first instance: Han Yujun, lawyer of Tianjin First Law Firm.

Defense counsel at second instance: Yuan Wei, lawyer of Beijing Tianping Law Firm.

Defendant: Zhang Hongbin, male, 60 years old, from Hebei Province, former Director of the Secondary Specialized Education Division of the Tianjin Education Enrollment Examination Center, arrested on June 18, 1996.

Defense counsel: Wang Jianren, lawyer of Tianjin First Law Firm.

Defendant: Zhang Zetian, male, 53 years old, from Tianjin, former Deputy Director of the Secondary Specialized Education Division of the Tianjin Education Enrollment Examination Center, arrested on June 18, 1996.

Defense counsel: Zhang Jian, lawyer of Hantian Law Firm.

Defendant: Li Shuqing, male, 61 years old, from Tianjin, former Director of the Administrative Division of the Tianjin Education Enrollment Examination Center, arrested on July 2, 1996.

Defense counsel: Wan Xiaoxia, lawyer of Fazheng Law Firm.

Defendant: Fan Benkui, male, 55 years old, Han ethnicity, from Tianjin, former Deputy Director of the Tianjin Education Enrollment Examination Center, released on bail pending trial on June 26, 1996.

Defense counsel: Liu Naiqiang and Hong Zhi, lawyers of Tianjin Tian Ding Law Firm.

The case of defendants Gao Yulin, Zhang Hongbin, Zhang Zetian, Li Shuqing, and Fan Benkui for embezzlement and bribery was brought to public prosecution by the First Branch of the Tianjin People's Procuratorate to the Tianjin First Intermediate People's Court.

The Tianjin First Intermediate People's Court found through open trial: From October to December 1992, to resolve the issue of quotas for some local students wishing to apply for secondary specialized schools, the enrollment offices of Jinghai County, Baodi County, Ji County, and Wuqing County in Tianjin respectively requested defendant Fan Benkui to help solve the problem. Fan Benkui reported the matter to defendant Gao Yulin, who expressed agreement and proposed to collect some fees. Fan Benkui conveyed Gao Yulin's opinion to defendant Zhang Zetian, and at the same time, using his authority, allocated additional quotas for secondary specialized school enrollment to the above counties; Zhang Zetian collected fees from these counties under the name of "education support fee" by issuing informal receipts based on the quotas. Gao Yulin instructed Fan Benkui and Zhang Zetian to embezzle RMB 190,000 of the "education support fee" collected. Among this, Gao Yulin received RMB 100,000 in illicit money, Fan Benkui received RMB 50,000, and Zhang Zetian received RMB 40,000.

Between October and December 1994, defendant Gao Yulin instructed defendants Zhang Hongbin and Zhang Zetian, during the secondary specialized school admission work at the examination center, to allocate additional enrollment quotas and collect "education support fees" without recording them in the accounts, thereby embezzling RMB 367,500 of the "education support fee" submitted by the Enrollment Office of the Jinghai County Education Bureau and the Affiliated Secondary Specialized School of Tianjin Conservatory of Music. Among this, Gao Yulin received RMB 180,000 in illicit money, and Zhang Hongbin and Zhang Zetian each received RMB 93,750.

Between October and December 1995, defendants Gao Yulin, Zhang Hongbin, and Zhang Zetian again adopted the above methods and embezzled RMB 470,000 of the "education support fee" submitted by the Enrollment Office of the Jinghai County Education Bureau and the Affiliated Secondary Specialized School of Tianjin Conservatory of Music. Among this, Gao Yulin received RMB 180,000 in illicit money, and Zhang Hongbin and Zhang Zetian each received RMB 145,000.

Between 1986 and October 1995, defendants Gao Yulin, Zhang Hongbin, and Li Shuqing, together with others (handled in separate cases), in selling college entrance examination compilations, materials, and enrollment newspapers to the enrollment offices of 18 districts and counties under Tianjin, embezzled public funds totaling RMB 534,221.36 by receiving payments without recording them in the accounts. Among this, Gao Yulin received RMB 255,815.36 in illicit money; Zhang Hongbin received RMB 130,203; Li Shuqing received RMB 139,203.

In June 1994, when defendant Gao Yulin was printing materials for this unit at a printing factory in Daxing County, Beijing, he increased the printing fee by RMB 30,000. Gao Yulin used RMB 13,000 of this to purchase a set of Sony audio equipment made in Japan and kept it for himself.

In January 1993, defendant Gao Yulin instructed defendants Fan Benkui and Zhang Zetian to withdraw RMB 10,620 from the "education support fee" submitted by the enrollment offices of various district and county education bureaus to purchase a set of high-end sofas for personal use.

Between June 1994 and January 1996, during the secondary specialized school admission work at the Tianjin Education Enrollment Examination Center, defendants Zhang Hongbin and Zhang Zetian, on the pretext of insufficient office funds and the need to improve office conditions, collected "education support fees" totaling RMB 314,500 from seven units, including the School for Children of Employees of the First Company of China Construction Sixth Engineering Bureau, Tianjin Finance and Economics School, and the Secondary Education Division of the Tianjin Education Bureau, without recording them in the accounts, and then divided the spoils. Among this, Zhang Hongbin received RMB 154,500, and Zhang Zetian received RMB 160,000.

Between October 1993 and 1995, defendants Zhang Hongbin and Zhang Zetian, in response to requests from various secondary specialized schools, when solving problems for these schools regarding student sources, enrollment plans, and children's schooling, accepted kickbacks totaling RMB 68,000 from 18 secondary specialized schools and individuals. Among this, Zhang Hongbin accepted RMB 29,750, and Zhang Zetian accepted RMB 38,250.

In summary, defendant Gao Yulin embezzled public funds totaling RMB 739,435.36; after the case was uncovered, illicit money and goods totaling over RMB 300,000 were recovered. Defendant Zhang Hongbin embezzled public funds totaling RMB 523,453 and accepted bribes of RMB 29,750; after the case was uncovered, illicit money of over RMB 458,000 was recovered. Defendant Zhang Zetian embezzled public funds totaling RMB 438,750 and accepted bribes of RMB 38,250; after the case was uncovered, illicit money of RMB 300,800 was recovered. Defendant Li Shuqing embezzled public funds totaling RMB 139,203, all of which have been recovered in the case. Defendant Fan Benkui embezzled public funds totaling RMB 50,000, all of which have been recovered in the case.

The above facts are confirmed by witness testimony, documentary evidence, physical evidence, and handwriting examination reports. The confessions of each defendant are basically consistent with other evidence and can corroborate each other. The facts are clear and the evidence is conclusive.

Defendant Gao Yulin argued that he only received over RMB 400,000, not over RMB 700,000, and that the money he received was not public funds. Defendant Zhang Hongbin admitted that the money in his possession was public funds but contended that it was merely "off-the-books" funds held personally by him. The defense counsels for the two defendants argued that Gao Yulin and Zhang Hongbin only distributed the "surplus" funds obtained from "arbitrary charges" and the sale of college entrance examination compilation materials, etc., beyond the costs, and did not embezzle public property; there was no conclusive evidence proving that Gao Yulin received RMB 180,000 in 1994. Defendants Zhang Zetian, Li Shuqing, and Fan Benkui all admitted to the criminal facts charged in the indictment. The defense counsels for the three defendants argued that the three defendants had good attitudes toward admitting guilt and were all accomplices, requesting a lighter punishment.

The Tianjin First Intermediate People's Court held that the funds collected by defendants Gao Yulin, Zhang Hongbin, Zhang Zetian, Li Shuqing, and Fan Benkui under the fabricated name of "education support fee" using their authority should belong to the state. Gao Yulin, Zhang Hongbin, Zhang Zetian, Li Shuqing, and Fan Benkui, as state functionaries, took advantage of their positions to embezzle public funds, and the amounts were especially huge, violating the provisions of Article 1, Paragraph 1 of the Supplementary Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Punishing the Crimes of Embezzlement and Bribery, and all constituted the crime of embezzlement, and should be punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 2(1) of the said Supplementary Decision. The criminal facts charged by the procuratorial authority against Gao Yulin and Zhang Hongbin were all examined and verified in court, with clear facts, conclusive evidence, and accurate characterization; the justifications for the two defendants' defenses were untenable. Gao Yulin first proposed the criminal intent and instructed the division of spoils, playing a principal role in the joint crime. In accordance with Article 23 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, he was the principal offender in this case and should bear criminal responsibility for the entire amount of the joint embezzlement crime. Moreover, he personally embezzled an especially huge amount of public funds, the circumstances of the crime were especially serious, and the social impact was extremely adverse, so a heavier punishment should be imposed. Zhang Hongbin, Zhang Zetian, Li Shuqing, and Fan Benkui embezzled public funds under the instruction of Gao Yulin. In accordance with Article 24 of the Criminal Law, they were all accomplices and should be given a lighter punishment compared to the principal offender based on the circumstances of each defendant's crime. Among them, Fan Benkui reported and exposed the crimes of other defendants, which was verified, and had meritorious performance. In accordance with Articles 63, 59, and 67 of the Criminal Law, he could be given a mitigated punishment. Zhang Hongbin and Zhang Zetian took advantage of their positions to accept bribes from others, violating the provisions of Article 4 of the Supplementary Decision on Punishing the Crimes of Embezzlement and Bribery, and constituted the crime of bribery. They should be punished in accordance with Articles 5 and 2 of the said Supplementary Decision. Zhang Hongbin and Zhang Zetian each committed two crimes, and in accordance with Article 64 of the Criminal Law, they should be subjected to cumulative punishment for multiple crimes. In accordance with Article 12 of the Supplementary Decision on Punishing the Crimes of Embezzlement and Bribery, the public property embezzled by each defendant recovered in this case should be returned to the original unit. Accordingly, the Tianjin First Intermediate People's Court rendered the following judgment on April 17, 1997:

1. Defendant Gao Yulin is convicted of embezzlement and sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life, and forfeiture of property of RMB 20,000.

Defendant Zhang Hongbin is convicted of embezzlement and sentenced to life imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for life, and forfeiture of property of RMB 20,000; convicted of bribery and sentenced to five years' imprisonment; the sentences are to be executed concurrently as life imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for life, and forfeiture of property of RMB 20,000.

Defendant Zhang Zetian is convicted of embezzlement and sentenced to life imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for life, and forfeiture of property of RMB 20,000; convicted of bribery and sentenced to six years' imprisonment; the sentences are to be executed concurrently as life imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for life, and forfeiture of property of RMB 20,000.

Defendant Li Shuqing is convicted of embezzlement and sentenced to ten years' imprisonment, with forfeiture of property of RMB 10,000.

Defendant Fan Benkui is convicted of embezzlement and sentenced to three years' imprisonment, suspended for five years, with forfeiture of property of RMB 10,000.

2. The illicit money and goods transferred with the case are to be returned to the Tianjin Education Enrollment Examination Center.

3. The remaining illicit money from the embezzlement by defendants Gao Yulin, Zhang Hongbin, and Zhang Zetian shall continue to be recovered.

After the judgment was pronounced at first instance, defendant Gao Yulin appealed to the Tianjin High People's Court based on his original defense reasons.

During the second instance trial of the Tianjin High People's Court, appellant Gao Yulin admitted that the criminal facts found at first instance were true and surrendered illicit money of RMB 430,000.

After trial, the Tianjin High People's Court held that the facts in the first instance judgment were clear, the evidence was reliable and sufficient, the convictions were accurate, and the trial procedures were lawful. Appellant Gao Yulin first proposed the criminal intent and instructed the division of spoils in the joint crime, playing a principal role and being the principal offender, and should be given a heavier punishment according to law. His appellate reasons were untenable. In view of Gao Yulin's good attitude toward admitting guilt during the second instance and his full surrender of all illicit money and goods, his request for a lighter punishment could be accepted. Gao Yulin need not be executed immediately. The sentencing of defendants Zhang Hongbin, Zhang Zetian, Li Shuqing, and Fan Benkui in the first instance was appropriate and should be affirmed. Accordingly, in accordance with Articles 189(1) and (2) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Tianjin High People's Court rendered the following judgment on December 10, 1997:

1. The part of the first instance criminal judgment concerning the sentence of defendant Gao Yulin and the part concerning the continued recovery of the remaining illicit money from his embezzlement are revoked.

2. Appellant Gao Yulin is convicted of embezzlement and sentenced to death, with a two-year suspension of execution, deprivation of political rights for life, and forfeiture of property of RMB 20,000.

3. The parts of the first instance criminal judgment concerning the convictions and sentences of defendants Zhang Hongbin, Zhang Zetian, Li Shuqing, and Fan Benkui, and the continued recovery of the remaining illicit money from the embezzlement by Zhang Hongbin and Zhang Zetian, are affirmed.

In accordance with Article 202 of the Criminal Procedure Law, the Tianjin High People's Court, by the same judgment, approved the judgment sentencing Gao Yulin to death with a two-year suspension of execution and deprivation of political rights for life.
